root_cause: ListPatternTab accepts picker messages using only sender tab and current page. Its local generation protects injection rejection but is not sent to the producer or checked on messages. Cancel followed by a new pick on the same tab and URL therefore cannot distinguish old ITEM_DETECTED, RESULT, or EXIT messages. Cancellation invokes an unqualified global hook, so delayed cancellation can terminate the replacement session.
repair: Caller UUID travels through synchronous content installation and explicit start, every producer event, shared SW relay, and consumer filtering. Cancellation targets UUID. Cross-context teardown removes listeners. A picker-specific per-tab promise chain orders the two injection stages, stop, and replacement start; deferred-install guard and mutation proof pending.
